note: Each case except control-valid MUST be rejected. The category is the rejection class a conformant decoder reports; message text is implementation-defined. Envelopes carry the FSWNENC1 magic.

categories.magic: the eight magic bytes are neither FSWNENC1 nor WBLMENC1
categories.header: the chunk size or record count is out of range
categories.length-or-authentication: the body length is inconsistent, or a record fails to authenticate
categories.authentication: a record's GCM tag fails under its position-bound AAD
categories.recovery-key: the recovery key is not canonical

cases.description: the unmodified FSWNENC1 one-record envelope decrypts
first magic byte flipped, so it is neither FSWNENC1 nor WBLMENC1
the clear chunk-size field is not the expected 1 MiB
the record count is set to zero
a byte of the GCM authentication tag is flipped
a ciphertext body byte is flipped
the header nonce prefix is altered, which both moves the nonce and breaks the AAD
the two records' authentication tags are swapped, which the position-bound AAD rejects
a valid envelope decrypted under a different, valid key
the recovery key is not canonical unpadded base64url for 32 bytes
